#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <algorithm>

int main() {
    int n;
    std::string str;
    std::cin >> n >> str;

    int maxSize = 0;
    int currentSize = 0;
    int wordCount = 0;
    int state = 0; // 0 = outside parentheses, 1 = inside parentheses
    bool wordStarted = false;

    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        char c = str[i];

        if (c == '(') {
            if (currentSize != 0) {
                maxSize = std::max(maxSize, currentSize);
                currentSize = 0;
            }
            state = 1;
            wordStarted = false;
        } else if (c == ')') {
            if (currentSize != 0) {
                maxSize = std::max(maxSize, currentSize);
                currentSize = 0;
            }
            state = 0;
        } else if (state == 1) {
            if (!wordStarted && c != '_') {
                wordCount++;
                wordStarted = true;
            }
            if (c == '_') {
                wordStarted = false;
            }
        } else {
            if (c != '_') {
                currentSize++;
                if (i == n - 1) {
                    maxSize = std::max(maxSize, currentSize);
                }
            } else {
                if (currentSize != 0) {
                    maxSize = std::max(maxSize, currentSize);
                    currentSize = 0;
                }
            }
        }
    }

    std::cout << maxSize << " " << wordCount << std::endl;
    return 0;
}
